verdict.rationale: Docs describe the transfer flow, at-cost pricing, one-year extension to remaining registration time, and lock/unlock (EPP-style) status via clientTransferProhibited plus a troubleshooting timeframe for stuck transfers, and one community report calls transfers 'smooth.' But other hands-on reports directly contradict the cost/status-tracking honesty claim — users describe being double-charged or billed for domains Cloudflare 'does not control' post-transfer, which is a concrete counter-example rather than mere skepticism. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the auth-code/EPP-code entry step itself, and resolution of the billing-discrepancy reports.
